svg.title: ICN-EWTW-021200010-001-01 - eWTW ECS distribution ducting architecture
svg.desc: Typical cabin cross-section of the conditioned-air ducting arrangement, a typical duct-coupling detail, and a single-line schematic of the distribution network from the mix manifold to zone outlets and returns, for the AMPEL360 eWTW bleedless electric ECS.
svg.text: DISTRIBUTION — DUCTING ARCHITECTURE · 021-200-010 · COMMON INFORMATION OBJECT · PUBLICATION-NEUTRAL MASTER
VIEW A — TYPICAL CABIN CROSS-SECTION · DUCTING ARRANGEMENT (LOOKING FWD)
VIEW B — SINGLE-LINE SCHEMATIC · MAIN TRUNK, RISERS AND RETURNS

g.text: MAIN TRUNK · RISERS · OVERHEAD DISTRIBUTION · RETURNS
1 Single-line schematic representation; duct routing, lengths and diameters are indicative and not to scale.
2 Bleedless all-electric ECS: conditioned air enters the mix manifold from E-PACK 1 / 2 (packs: REF 021-510; general arrangement and zoning: REF 021-000-010).
3 Trim air is low-flow warm air from the E-pack hot section, injected at each zone riser; distribution control and balancing: REF 021-200-030.
4 Recirculation path: dado return → HEPA filtration → mix manifold. Lav / galley extraction air is not recirculated (pressure control: REF 021-300).
5 Callout items 1–14: see ITEM · NOMENCLATURE. DETAIL C is typical for trunk, riser and header couplings.
